music.name: bed_v1
music.prompt: Bright, playful, warm acoustic pop instrumental for a cosy tea-shop product reel, exactly 112 BPM, 4/4, starts at once on the downbeat with the full groove, no intro, no fade-in. Plucked felt marimba and pizzicato strings play steady, bouncy sixteenth notes; a soft round kick on every beat; light hand claps on 2 and 4; a little upright bass; a celesta sparkle now and then. Dry, close, crisp transients, tight and clean, no reverb wash, no vocals.

sfx.name: box_thud_a
sfx.prompt: A small cardboard tea box dropped from about 20 cm lands flat on a solid oiled walnut sideboard: one short dull papery thud, a faint rattle of loose tea leaves inside, close-miked, dry, no room echo.

sfx.name: box_thud_b
sfx.prompt: A light paperboard box of loose-leaf tea falls a short way onto a hardwood shelf: a soft, muffled cardboard tap-thud with a tiny rustle of tea inside, very close and dry.

sfx.name: box_thud_c
sfx.prompt: A cardboard tea carton lands on a wooden counter top: a quick hollow card thump, a whisper of dry leaves shifting inside, intimate studio foley, no reverb.

sfx.name: box_thud_d
sfx.prompt: A small boxed tea dropped onto a walnut table: a compact low cardboard knock with a slight papery edge, loose tea settling inside, dry close foley.

sfx.name: box_thud_heavy
sfx.prompt: A cardboard tea box dropped onto a walnut sideboard lands on one edge then slaps flat: a fuller cardboard thud followed a fraction later by a softer second tap as it rocks and settles, loose tea rattling inside, close and dry.

sfx.name: logo_rise
sfx.prompt: A single soft upward glissando on a felt-mallet marimba that blooms into one warm, gentle bell-like note, cosy and clean, no reverb tail beyond a second.

sfx.name: shop_roomtone
sfx.prompt: Quiet room tone of a small empty tea shop in the afternoon: very soft distant street hush, faint fridge hum, nothing distinct, steady.
